##### Project general facts

Riverton House is a refined residential development where contemporary architecture meets the tranquility of a lagoon-side setting. The project presents a collection of spacious one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed with open layouts, expansive glazing, and seamless flow between living spaces. Clean architectural lines and elegant proportions are complemented by panoramic views of the community lagoon and Dubai skyline, creating a calm and sophisticated living environment defined by light, openness, and modern design.

Residents enjoy a curated selection of amenities designed to enhance both wellness and everyday comfort. An infinity pool overlooking the water, floating yoga deck, fitness studios, and sauna create a complete wellness experience, while treatment rooms offer spaces for relaxation and recovery. Families benefit from indoor and outdoor children’s play areas, landscaped parks, and a nursery, while social zones including a club lounge and communal dining areas encourage connection and community living in a serene natural setting.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, reflecting a modern and timeless aesthetic throughout. Open-plan kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, combining functionality with sleek design. The residences are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize each space, while premium finishes and thoughtful detailing ensure a refined and comfortable living experience from the outset.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan City is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan City offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan City is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan City have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan City, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
